ownership: Byte images are observations, not recovered class instances. No vtable, lifetime or host-pointer claim is implied.
Host calculations receive configurations separately and never dereference an original process address; pointer32 fields are emulated addresses only.
The base constructor clears owner 0x000..0x418; producers of every high-offset observation above that boundary are not yet established.
